title: Samir's Ribbon at the Parcel Table
youtube_title: Samir's Ribbon at the Parcel Table | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Sharing what you have enough of can help two good things go out into the world.
summary: Samir brings a long ribbon to tie a parcel at the post office, meets a child whose string has frayed, and shares the ribbon so both parcels can be mailed.
